column1: # Structural field marks for the Empidonax and Contopus flycatchers.
# build_pair_notes.py turns this into a note for every pair
# differs. Correct a row and every comparison that species appears in updates.
#   contrast      weak | medium | strong        (upperparts vs underparts)
#   habit         free text: wing and tail movement

column15: flicks wings and tail in a shiver just after landing
column16: song a rapid run of pip notes or chuwee-chuwee; call pip

column15: perches motionless and erect on tall dead snags; rarely flicks
column16: song quick-three-beers; call a hollow pip often in threes

column15: very rarely flicks wings or tail
column16: song Jose-Maria; call pip or peeeur

column15: rarely flicks; sallies high and returns to the same snag
column16: song a burry descending BREeeer; call a flat pee

column15: rarely flicks; sallies high and returns to the same snag
column16: song a slurred PEE-a-weeeEEE rising at the end; call pip

column15: sedate; flicks less than other empids
column16: song an explosive pwit-sip; call a squeaky pweek
song a sneezing FITZ-brrrew; call a liquid whit
song free-BREER-o; call a flat pip - never a whit

column15: flicks wings and tail often; shy and keeps to shade
column16: song che-bunk; call a sharp pip
song PE-u-WEEET or chew-wit; call a thin tseet
song PIT-tic given in quick succession; call a flat pip - never a whit

column15: pumps its tail continuously; up and down at the same speed
column16: song PIT-tic or bean-dip given slowly; call a soft liquid whit
song pip puweee; calls pip and whit and a thin tseet

column15: drops its tail slowly after raising it - the only empid that does
column16: song che-bec; call a short abrupt whit
song a hard che-bek in rapid succession; call a sharp husky whit

column15: flicks wings and tail occasionally; perches mid-canopy
column16: song pirrip pirrip pu-reee; call a hard pit
